name: kaying-for-unity-marketplace
description: WorkBuddy plugins from the kaying-for-unity project: Unity's official game-development skills — 31 skills covering UI (UI Toolkit / uGUI / IMGUI), the full 2D and Tilemap set, AI navigation, 3D physics, URP migration and post-processing, sprite editing, Shader Graph custom nodes, audio and TextMeshPro optimization, multiplayer and Vivox voice, IAP and LevelPlay ads, Unity Services live-ops, localization, and Unity CLI / Editor automation.

plugins.name: unity
plugins.description: Unity's official game development plugin, packaged for WorkBuddy. Build, monetize, and operate Unity games with guidance grounded in Unity's documented practices. 31 skills spanning UI (uGUI / UI Toolkit / IMGUI), the full 2D and Tilemap set, AI navigation, 3D physics, URP migration and post-processing, sprite editing, Shader Graph custom nodes, audio and TextMeshPro optimization, multiplayer and Vivox voice chat, in-app purchases and LevelPlay ad mediation, Unity Services live-ops, localization, and Unity CLI / Editor automation.
